_description: Labeled relevance corpus for the 234-skill real-corpus retrieval quality sweep (#210). Unlike retrieval_quality_labeled.json (toy 8-skill fixture), this file targets the REAL live corpus in skill_layer_test with 234 active/ready skills. Queries authored OFFLINE from skill content read from PG WITHOUT running the retriever — no flatter-bias. Split: 20 anchor skills for TUNING, 15 anchor skills for HELD-OUT evaluation (disjoint). Both sets include lexical and disjoint query kinds plus negatives. Anchors are the hard recall targets.
_authoring_protocol: Each query was derived by reading the anchor skill's description and subunits from Postgres (offline, no retriever access). Lexical queries share key terms with the skill. Disjoint queries paraphrase the skill's intent using vocabulary NOT appearing in the skill's name, description, or tags. The retriever was NOT run during authoring to prevent flatter-bias. Authoring date: 2026-06-07, corpus snapshot: 234 skills (179 global + 55 project).
_target_set: FROZEN BEFORE SWEEP: MRR >= 0.80, nDCG@3 >= 0.80, no_match precision >= 0.90
_split: tuning_anchors (20) vs held_out_anchors (15), disjoint by anchor skill

_thresholds.note: FROZEN target committed BEFORE the tuning sweep per the #210 contract. Do NOT lower these to force green.
